overlap.$description: Overlap between avatars (37.5% of 32px diameter) for tight, cohesive grouping

overlapLead.$description: Overlap after lead avatar (18.75% of 32px) for visual separation from lead

overlapTight.$description: Tighter overlap after lead (50% of 32px) creates cohesive subgroup

maxVisible.$description: Maximum avatars before showing count indicator (component logic reference)

spread.$description: Spacing when hovering (neighbors spread out for visibility)

scale.$description: Scale factor for hovered avatar (slight enlargement for emphasis)

duration.$description: Animation duration for hover spread effect

easing.$description: Animation easing function for hover spread effect

gap.$description: Gap between avatar group and counter (no overlap)
